agents.note: US-409 DONE (passes:true) -- SPRINT 50/V0.29.4 EDR reader story (PRODUCER side; US-410 = sibling persistence subscriber, US-411 = end-to-end harness). CONTRACT (ADR sections 1/3): IMU one burst per poll (accel+gyro+mag+temp) -> raw.imu.{accel,gyro,mag,temp} all carrying the SAME seq (atomic: read all before publish so a mid-read fault emits nothing for that seq -> US-410 assembles 1 edr_imu_sample row per seq); light -> raw.light.lux (None on saturation/non-finite, never inf) + raw.light.raw counts, own independent seq. Flag-on-but-absent takes this path (proven via injected raiser AND real default factory on the dev box). Present -> retained state.sensor.*=present + daemon poll at sampleHz. STATE encoded as float (PRESENT=1.0/ABSENT=0.0) + 'present'/'absent' unit label (Sample.value envelope is numeric; test_bus_state.py precedent). ADDITIVE: only raw.imu.*/raw.light.*/state.sensor.* -- a raw.obd.* subscriber gets nothing (tested); producer never blocks (LOSSY is subscriber-side). FLAGS: pi.sensors.{imu,light}.enabled default False, each REQUIRE pi.bus.enabled (enforced in createSensorReadersFromConfig); sampleHz 50/1. SCOPE-FENCE: NOT wired into lifecycle.py (US-410 wires reader-start + subscriber) + did NOT add persistHz/retentionDays (US-410 keys).
